---
title: "Inputs for Western Mediterranean EwE models"
subtitle: "Biomass, catch, effort, P/B, Q/B, diets and validation for Ecopath with Ecosim, built from surveys, fisheries data and the literature"
author: "Daniel Vilas"
date: today
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    number-sections: true
    code-fold: true
    code-tools: true
    theme: cosmo
params:
  ## Inputs of the pipeline run done by this document. Change a value and
  ## click Render: the pipeline reruns with these values and the HTML shows
  ## the new plots and tables. Values are R expressions.
  model_gsas: "1:12"              # GSAs of the model area, e.g. "c(6, 7)"
  model_area_basis: "whole_gsa"   # "whole_gsa" or "medits_10_800"
  year_ecopath: "1994:1996"       # Ecopath baseline years
  ts_years: "1995:2023"           # Ecosim biomass years
  ## catch/effort years follow the Ecopath and Ecosim years (run_pipeline_demo.R)
  ## What the render reruns before building the HTML:
  ##   "all"        - the whole pipeline 01 -> 05 with the inputs above
  ##                  (about 10 min; the first run after a change needs internet)
  ##   "validation" - only 05_validation.R (redraws the validation plots)
  ##   "none"       - nothing; uses the outputs already on disk
  regenerate: "none"
server: shiny
execute:
  eval: false
  echo: true
  freeze: false   # overrides the site's freeze: auto for THIS document specifically -
                   # this doc's setup chunk copies PNGs from an external out_dir/plots
                   # folder that changes independently of the .qmd's own source code,
                   # which is exactly the case freeze:auto can't detect (it only checks
                   # whether the .qmd's OWN code changed, not files it reads at render
                   # time) - so this doc always re-executes fully, every render
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-copy-figures
#| context: setup
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| include: false

## Folders on this laptop: wmed_paths.R (config.local.R, then config.R,
## then the standard pCloud Drive location; see that file). This .qmd sits
## in <git_dir>/scripts, and knitr runs in that folder.
git_dir <- normalizePath("..")
source(file.path(git_dir, "scripts", "wmed_paths.R"))
.wp <- wmed_find_paths(git_dir)
message("git_dir: ", .wp$git_dir, "\npcloud_dir: ", .wp$pcloud_dir, "\nout_dir: ", .wp$out_dir)

## --- Regenerate the pipeline outputs before copying them (params$regenerate) ---
## Runs run_pipeline_demo.R in a SEPARATE R process (Rscript), so the
## pipeline's own clean start cannot touch this document's objects; folders
## are found by wmed_paths.R as for a normal run. The full log of each script is
## in out_dir as usual; a failed step stops the render with its message.
.regen <- if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$regenerate)) params$regenerate else "none"
if (!identical(.regen, "none")) {
  .steps <- switch(.regen, validation = "5", all = "1:5",
                   stop("params$regenerate must be \"none\", \"validation\" or \"all\" (got \"", .regen, "\")."))
  .demo <- file.path(git_dir, "scripts", "run_pipeline_demo.R")
  message("Regenerating pipeline outputs (", .regen, ", steps ", .steps, ") with ", .demo, " ...")
  .old_wd <- setwd(file.path(git_dir, "scripts"))
  .p <- function(x, default) if (!is.null(params[[x]])) as.character(params[[x]]) else default
  .code <- paste0("CLEAN_START <- FALSE; RUN_STEPS <- ", .steps,
                  "; MODEL_GSAS <- ", .p("model_gsas", "1:12"),
                  "; MODEL_AREA_BASIS <- '", .p("model_area_basis", "whole_gsa"), "'",
                  "; YEAR_ECOPATH <- ", .p("year_ecopath", "1994:1996"),
                  "; TS_YEARS <- ", .p("ts_years", "1995:2023"),
                  "; source('run_pipeline_demo.R')")
  message("Pipeline call: ", .code)
  .status <- system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"), c("-e", shQuote(.code)))
  setwd(.old_wd)
  if (!identical(.status, 0L)) stop("run_pipeline_demo.R failed (exit status ", .status, ") - see the logs in out_dir.")
  message("Pipeline outputs regenerated.")
}

## --- Figures in the text -------------------------------------------------
## Each figure is loaded LIVE from out_dir when the page opens (the
## run-server chunk serves the file), so it always shows the latest run,
## on any laptop. Nothing is copied at render time. Paths are relative
## to out_dir.

  "survey_sample_coverage_map_by_year.png"            = "plots/biomass/survey_sample_coverage_map_by_year.png",
  "survey_fg_density_timeseries.png"                  = "plots/biomass/survey_fg_density_timeseries.png",
  "survey_fg_density_timeseries_regional.png"         = "plots/biomass/survey_fg_density_timeseries_regional.png",
  "survey_fg_depth_strata_profile.png"                = "plots/biomass/survey_fg_depth_strata_profile.png",
  "custom_survey_sample_coverage_map.png"             = "custom_region/plots/survey_sample_coverage_map.png",
  "custom_survey_fg_density_timeseries.png"           = "custom_region/plots/survey_fg_density_timeseries.png",
  "biomass_by_fg_source.png"                          = "plots/biomass/biomass_by_fg_source.png",
  "biomass_survey_fg_density_timeseries_regional.png" = "plots/biomass/survey_fg_density_timeseries_regional.png",
  "07_catch_by_fg_and_fleet.png"                      = "plots/fisheries/07_catch_by_fg_and_fleet.png",
  "08_discards_by_fg_and_fleet.png"                   = "plots/fisheries/08_discards_by_fg_and_fleet.png",
  "pipeline_01_catches_per_FG.png"                    = "plots/fisheries/01_catches_per_FG.png",
  "05_effort_by_country_fleet.png"                    = "plots/fisheries/05_effort_by_country_fleet.png",
  "fg_pb_qb_scatter.png"                              = "plots/validation/fg_pb_qb_scatter.png",
  "F_by_fg.png"                                       = "plots/validation/F_by_fg.png",
  "PQ_ratio_by_fg.png"                                = "plots/validation/PQ_ratio_by_fg.png",
  "biomass_vs_old_model_by_fg.png"                    = "plots/validation/biomass_vs_old_model_by_fg.png",
  "11_zooplankton_total_field_check.png"              = "plots/validation/11_zooplankton_total_field_check.png",
  "diet_matrix_heatmap.png"                           = "plots/diets/diet_matrix_heatmap.png")

## A figure kept in the repo (e.g. ewe_infography.jpg at the repo root),
## also loaded live, so an edited image shows without re-rendering.
wm_repo_figure <- function(id, caption, rel) {
  blank <- "data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw=="
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf('![%s](%s){#%s data-wmrepo="%s" width="100%%"}\n\n', caption, blank, id, rel))
}

## A markdown figure (caption, Quarto cross-reference id) whose image the
## page fills in from out_dir; a figure not produced yet shows a note.
wm_figure <- function(id, caption, name, script_hint) {
  rel <- unname(.fig_src[name]); if (is.na(rel)) rel <- name
  blank <- "data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw=="
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf('![%s](%s){#%s data-wmfile="%s" data-wmhint="%s" width="100%%"}\n\n',
                             caption, blank, id, rel, gsub('"', "'", script_hint)))
}
```

## Configure and run the pipeline {#sec-configure}

Pick the model area on the map, set the years and options, and click **Run pipeline**. The run (01 → 05) goes in the background with exactly the settings shown in the *Settings block* box; when it finishes, the plots at the bottom and the tables in the output folder are updated. A full run takes about 10 minutes (the first run after a change of GSAs needs internet for the bathymetry). The same settings block can be copied or downloaded to run the pipeline from the R console instead.

This works when the document is opened with **Run Document** in RStudio (or `quarto serve medbs_pipeline_methodology.qmd` in a terminal). A plain HTML file opened from disk shows the page but cannot run R.

```{r}
#| label: run-ui
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
library(shiny)
## GFCM GSA polygons (official GFCM_GSA.zip, simplified to 5 % of the
## vertices for display; GSA 11 has two polygons, W and E Sardinia).
.gsa_geojson <- if (file.exists("gsa_boundaries_westmed.geojson"))
  paste(readLines("gsa_boundaries_westmed.geojson", warn = FALSE), collapse = "") else "null"
.gsa_names <- c("Northern Alboran", "Alboran Island", "Southern Alboran", "Algeria", "Balearic Islands",
                "Northern Spain", "Gulf of Lion", "Corsica", "Ligurian & N Tyrrhenian", "S & C Tyrrhenian", "Sardinia", "Northern Tunisia")
.card <- function(step, title, icon, ..., class = "") {
  tags$div(class = paste("card wm-card mb-3", class),
           tags$div(class = "card-header wm-card-header",
                    tags$span(class = "wm-step", step), tags$span(class = "wm-icon", icon), title),
           tags$div(class = "card-body", ...))
}
.switch <- function(id, label, help, value = TRUE) {
  tags$div(class = "form-check form-switch wm-switch",
           tags$input(class = "form-check-input", type = "checkbox", role = "switch", id = id,
                      checked = if (value) NA else NULL),
           tags$label(class = "form-check-label", `for` = id, label),
           tags$div(class = "wm-help", help))
}

  tags$script(type = "application/json", id = "wm-gsa-geojson", HTML(.gsa_geojson)),
  tags$script(HTML(r"---(
(function () {
  var UNSURVEYED = [3, 4, 12];
  function checked() {
    return $('input[name="gsas"]:checked').map(function () { return +this.value; }).get();
  }
  function setGsas(list) {
    var boxes = $('input[name="gsas"]');
    boxes.each(function () { $(this).prop('checked', list.indexOf(+this.value) !== -1); });
    boxes.first().trigger('change');
  }
  function init() {
    if (typeof L === 'undefined' || !document.getElementById('wm-map')) { return setTimeout(init, 200); }
    var map = L.map('wm-map', { scrollWheelZoom: false, zoomSnap: 0.25 });
    // Esri Ocean basemap (no API key); falls back to OpenStreetMap if its tiles fail
    var base = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Ocean/World_Ocean_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
      attribution: 'Tiles &copy; Esri - GEBCO, NOAA, Garmin', maxZoom: 10 }).addTo(map);
    var fails = 0;
    base.on('tileerror', function () {
      if (++fails === 3) {
        map.removeLayer(base);
        L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
          attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors', maxZoom: 10 }).addTo(map);
      }
    });
    var data = null;
    try { data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('wm-gsa-geojson').textContent); } catch (e) {}
    var layer = null, rect = null;
    function style(f) {
      var g = f.properties.gsa_num, on = checked().indexOf(g) !== -1, uns = UNSURVEYED.indexOf(g) !== -1;
      return { color: on ? '#0b4f6c' : '#8a99a6', weight: on ? 1.5 : 1,
               fillColor: on ? (uns ? '#f0a202' : '#1b7f9e') : '#d5dde3', fillOpacity: on ? 0.5 : 0.15 };
    }
    if (data) {
      layer = L.geoJSON(data, {
        style: style,
        onEachFeature: function (f, l) {
          var g = f.properties.gsa_num;
          l.bindTooltip('GSA ' + g + ' - ' + f.properties.SMU_NAME +
                        (UNSURVEYED.indexOf(g) !== -1 ? ' (no MEDITS)' : ''), { sticky: true });
          l.on('click', function () {
            if ($('input[name="area_mode"]:checked').val() !== 'westmed') return;
            var s = checked(), i = s.indexOf(g);
            if (i === -1) s.push(g); else s.splice(i, 1);
            setGsas(s);
          });
          l.on('mouseover', function () { l.setStyle({ weight: 3 }); });
          l.on('mouseout', function () { layer.resetStyle(l); });
        }
      }).addTo(map);
      map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), { padding: [10, 10] });
      var legend = L.control({ position: 'topright' });
      legend.onAdd = function () {
        var d = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'wm-legend');
        d.innerHTML = '<i style="background:#1b7f9e"></i>In the model, MEDITS survey<br>' +
                      '<i style="background:#f0a202"></i>In the model, no survey (GSA 3, 4, 12)<br>' +
                      '<i style="background:#d5dde3"></i>Not in the model';
        return d;
      };
      legend.addTo(map);
    } else { map.setView([39, 5], 5); }
    var shapeLayer = null, shapeData = null;
    function drawBox() {
      if (rect) { map.removeLayer(rect); rect = null; }
      if (shapeLayer) { map.removeLayer(shapeLayer); shapeLayer = null; }
      var custom = $('input[name="area_mode"]:checked').val() === 'custom';
      if (layer) layer.setStyle(custom ? { fillOpacity: 0.05, color: '#b8c4cc', weight: 1 } : style);
      if (!custom) { if (layer) layer.setStyle(style); return; }
      if ($('input[name="custom_type"]:checked').val() === 'shapefile') {
        if (shapeData) {
          shapeLayer = L.geoJSON(shapeData, { style: { color: '#d9480f', weight: 2, fillOpacity: 0.25 } }).addTo(map);
          map.fitBounds(shapeLayer.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 9 });
        }
        return;
      }
      var v = ['bbox_xmin', 'bbox_xmax', 'bbox_ymin', 'bbox_ymax'].map(function (id) { return parseFloat($('#' + id).val()); });
      if (v.every(function (x) { return !isNaN(x); }) && v[1] > v[0] && v[3] > v[2]) {
        rect = L.rectangle([[v[2], v[0]], [v[3], v[1]]], { color: '#d9480f', weight: 2, fillOpacity: 0.15 }).addTo(map);
      }
    }
    $(document).on('change', 'input[name="gsas"]', function () { if (layer) layer.setStyle(style); });
    $(document).on('change', 'input[name="area_mode"], input[name="custom_type"]', drawBox);
    function onShape(m) { shapeData = m.geojson ? JSON.parse(m.geojson) : null; drawBox(); }
    if (window.Shiny && Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler) Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('wm-custom-shape', onShape);
    $(document).on('input change', '#bbox_xmin, #bbox_xmax, #bbox_ymin, #bbox_ymax', drawBox);
    $(document).on('click', '.wm-quick .btn', function () {
      var s = String($(this).data('gsas'));
      setGsas(s ? s.split(',').map(Number) : []);
    });
    $(document).on('click', '#wm-copy', function () {
      var btn = this;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText($('#config_text').text()).then(function () {
        btn.textContent = 'Copied!'; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1200);
      });
    });
    setTimeout(function () { map.invalidateSize(); if (layer) map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), { padding: [10, 10] }); }, 400);
  }
  $(init);

  // --- Zoomable plot viewer: click a plot, wheel or +/- to zoom, drag to move, Esc to close
  var lb, img, sc = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0, drag = null;
  function apply() { img.style.transform = 'translate(' + tx + 'px,' + ty + 'px) scale(' + sc + ')'; }
  function fit() {
    var w = img.naturalWidth, h = img.naturalHeight, W = window.innerWidth, H = window.innerHeight;
    sc = Math.min(W / w, (H - 60) / h, 1); tx = (W - w * sc) / 2; ty = (H - h * sc) / 2 + 20; apply();
  }
  function zoomAt(f, cx, cy) {
    var ns = Math.min(Math.max(sc * f, 0.1), 8);
    tx = cx - (cx - tx) * ns / sc; ty = cy - (cy - ty) * ns / sc; sc = ns; apply();
  }
  function build() {
    lb = $('<div id="wm-lightbox"><div class="wm-lb-bar">' +
           '<button data-z="in">+</button><button data-z="out">&minus;</button>' +
           '<button data-z="fit">Fit</button><button data-z="full">100%</button><button data-z="close">Close &times;</button></div>' +
           '<img alt=""><div class="wm-lb-hint">Mouse wheel or +/- to zoom - drag to move - Esc to close</div></div>').appendTo('body');
    img = lb.find('img')[0];
    lb.on('click', 'button', function () {
      var z = $(this).data('z'), W = window.innerWidth / 2, H = window.innerHeight / 2;
      if (z === 'in') zoomAt(1.4, W, H); else if (z === 'out') zoomAt(1 / 1.4, W, H);
      else if (z === 'fit') fit(); else if (z === 'full') zoomAt(1 / sc, W, H); else lb.hide();
    });
    lb[0].addEventListener('wheel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); zoomAt(e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : 1 / 1.15, e.clientX, e.clientY); }, { passive: false });
    $(img).on('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); drag = { x: e.clientX - tx, y: e.clientY - ty }; img.style.cursor = 'grabbing'; });
    $(document).on('mousemove', function (e) { if (drag) { tx = e.clientX - drag.x; ty = e.clientY - drag.y; apply(); } });
    $(document).on('mouseup', function () { drag = null; if (img) img.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
    $(document).on('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') lb.hide(); });
  }
  function wmFilter() {
    var f = $('.wm-filter .btn.active').data('folder') || '', q = ($('#wm-search').val() || '').toLowerCase();
    $('.wm-thumb').each(function () {
      var ok = (!f || $(this).data('folder') === f) && (!q || String($(this).data('name')).indexOf(q) !== -1);
      $(this).toggle(ok);
    });
  }
  $(document).on('click', '.wm-filter .btn', function () {
    $('.wm-filter .btn').removeClass('active'); $(this).addClass('active'); wmFilter();
  });
  $(document).on('input', '#wm-search', wmFilter);
  // Figures in the text: their image comes from out_dir through the Shiny session
  function wmFillFiles(m) {
    $('img[data-wmrepo]').each(function () {
      var el = this;
      el.onerror = function () {
        $(el).replaceWith($('<div class="alert alert-secondary small"></div>').text('Image not found in the repo: ' + $(el).data('wmrepo')));
      };
      el.src = m.repo + '&f=' + encodeURIComponent($(el).data('wmrepo')) + '&v=' + m.v; el.style.cursor = 'zoom-in';
    });
    $('[data-wmfile]').each(function () {
      var el = this, url = m.base + '&f=' + encodeURIComponent($(el).data('wmfile')) + '&v=' + m.v;
      if (el.tagName === 'IMG') {
        el.onerror = function () {
          $(el).replaceWith($('<div class="alert alert-secondary small"></div>').text(
            'Figure not yet available (' + $(el).data('wmfile') + '): run ' + ($(el).data('wmhint') || 'the pipeline') + ' first.'));
        };
        el.src = url; el.style.cursor = 'zoom-in';
      } else { el.href = url; }
    });
  }
  if (window.Shiny && Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler) Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('wmfile-base', wmFillFiles);
  else $(document).on('shiny:connected', function () { Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('wmfile-base', wmFillFiles); });
  $(document).on('click', 'img[data-wmfile], img[data-wmrepo]', function () {
    if (!this.naturalWidth || this.naturalWidth < 2) return;
    if (!lb) build();
    img.onload = fit; img.src = this.src; lb.show();
    if (img.complete) fit();
  });
  $(document).on('click', '.wm-results img', function () {
    if (!this.src || this.naturalWidth === 0) return;
    if (!lb) build();
    img.onload = fit; img.src = this.src; lb.show();
    if (img.complete) fit();
  });
})();
)---"))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: run-server
#| context: server
#| eval: true
## Paths: found by wmed_paths.R, the same way run_pipeline_demo.R finds them.
.git_dir <- normalizePath("..")   # this .qmd sits in <git_dir>/scripts
source(file.path(.git_dir, "scripts", "wmed_paths.R"), local = TRUE)
.paths <- wmed_find_paths(.git_dir)  # config.local.R > config.R > standard pCloud Drive place
.out_dir <- .paths$out_dir
## Run files live in out_dir/.qmd_run (not in R's temporary folder), so a page
## reopened later still knows the last run started from here, and a run
## that is still going.
.run_dir <- if (!is.na(.out_dir) && dir.exists(.out_dir)) file.path(.out_dir, ".qmd_run") else file.path(tempdir(), "wmed_qmd_run")
dir.create(.run_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
.status_file <- file.path(.run_dir, "status.txt")       # "done" or "error: ..." when the run ends; its time = end
.console <- file.path(.run_dir, "console.txt")          # everything the run prints
.progress_file <- file.path(.run_dir, "progress.txt")   # "--- Step i/5 ..." lines
.pid_file <- file.path(.run_dir, "pid.txt")             # process id of the run
.settings_file <- file.path(.run_dir, "settings.R")     # settings block of the run; its time = start

## Whole-GSA area of each GSA from the map polygons (km2). An approximate
## preview only: 01 computes the real A_model from the GSA shapefile and
## the bathymetry (795,431 km2 for GSAs 1-11 in the 2026-10-15 run, before GSA 12 was added; the
## simplified polygons give about 1 % more).
.gsa_km2 <- tryCatch({
  g <- sf::st_read(file.path(.git_dir, "scripts", "gsa_boundaries_westmed.geojson"), quiet = TRUE)
  a <- tapply(as.numeric(sf::st_area(g)) / 1e6, g$gsa_num, sum)
  setNames(as.numeric(a), names(a))
}, error = function(e) NULL)
## Depth cells of the model area written by 01 (out_dir/biomass/
## model_area_cells.csv: GSA x depth band, km2, from the NOAA bathymetry).
## With whole_gsa it holds every depth band, so both bases can be summed
## from it: 10-800 m = cells with Depth_min_m >= 10 and Depth_max_m <= 800.
model_cells <- reactive({
  last_finished()
  f <- if (!is.na(.out_dir)) file.path(.out_dir, "biomass", "model_area_cells.csv") else ""
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  x <- tryCatch(utils::read.csv(f), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(x) || !all(c("AreaID", "Depth_min_m", "Depth_max_m", "area_km2") %in% names(x))) NULL else x
})
## --- Functional groups: the species -> FG csv the run uses -------------------
.pcloud_dir <- .paths$pcloud_dir
.fg_default <- if (!is.na(.pcloud_dir)) file.path(.pcloud_dir, "data", "FG_WMed_2026.csv") else NA_character_
.fg_choices <- if (!is.na(.pcloud_dir) && dir.exists(file.path(.pcloud_dir, "data")))
  list.files(file.path(.pcloud_dir, "data"), "^FG.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE) else character(0)
updateSelectInput(session, "fg_file", choices = setNames(.fg_choices, basename(.fg_choices)),
                  selected = if (.fg_default %in% .fg_choices) .fg_default else .fg_choices[1])
fg_path <- reactiveVal(.fg_default)
observeEvent(input$fg_file, if (nzchar(input$fg_file)) fg_path(input$fg_file))
observeEvent(input$fg_upload, {   # an uploaded csv is kept next to the run files so the run can read it
  dest <- file.path(.run_dir, paste0("uploaded_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_", input$fg_upload$name)))
  file.copy(input$fg_upload$datapath, dest, overwrite = TRUE)
  fg_path(dest)
})
fg_table <- reactive({
  f <- fg_path()
  if (is.na(f) || !file.exists(f)) return(list(error = paste("File not found:", f)))
  x <- tryCatch(data.table::fread(f, encoding = "UTF-8"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(x)) return(list(error = paste("Could not read", basename(f))))
  need <- c("FG_number", "FG_name", "species")
  if (!all(need %in% names(x))) return(list(error = paste0(basename(f), " is missing column(s): ", paste(setdiff(need, names(x)), collapse = ", "),
                                                         ". Columns found: ", paste(names(x), collapse = ", "))))
  list(data = x, path = f)
})
output$fg_summary <- renderUI({
  ft <- fg_table()
  if (!is.null(ft$error)) return(tags$div(class = "alert alert-danger py-2 small mb-0", ft$error))
  x <- data.table::copy(ft$data)
  has_group <- "FG_group" %in% names(x)
  x[, FG_number := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(FG_number))]
  fg <- x[!is.na(FG_number), .(FG_name = paste(unique(FG_name), collapse = " / "),
                               FG_group = if (has_group) paste(unique(stats::na.omit(FG_group)), collapse = " / ") else NA_character_,
                               n_species = data.table::uniqueN(species)), by = FG_number][order(FG_number)]
  ## Checks: one name per FG number, each species in one FG only, no gaps in the numbers
  multi_name <- fg[grepl(" / ", FG_name), FG_number]
  sp2 <- x[!is.na(species) & nzchar(species), .(n = data.table::uniqueN(FG_number)), by = species][n > 1, species]
  gaps <- setdiff(seq(min(fg$FG_number), max(fg$FG_number)), fg$FG_number)
  warn <- c(if (length(multi_name)) paste("FG number(s) with more than one FG_name:", paste(multi_name, collapse = ", ")),
            if (length(sp2)) paste0(length(sp2), " species in more than one FG (", paste(head(sp2, 3), collapse = ", "),
                                    if (length(sp2) > 3) ", ...", ") - expected only for multistanza groups such as hake juv./adult"),
            if (length(gaps)) paste("Missing FG number(s):", paste(gaps, collapse = ", ")),
            if (!has_group) "No FG_group column - add one to group the FGs (the diet heatmap then shows the groups as blocks).")
  stat <- function(label, value, note = NULL)
    column(3, tags$div(class = "wm-stat", tags$div(class = "l", label), tags$div(class = "v", value), if (!is.null(note)) tags$div(class = "n", note)))
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(fg)), function(i)
    tags$tr(tags$td(fg$FG_number[i]), tags$td(fg$FG_name[i]), if (has_group) tags$td(fg$FG_group[i]), tags$td(fg$n_species[i])))
  tagList(
    fluidRow(
      stat("File", basename(ft$path), format(file.mtime(ft$path), "edited %d %b %Y, %H:%M")),
      stat("Functional groups", nrow(fg), paste0("FG ", min(fg$FG_number), "-", max(fg$FG_number))),
      stat("Species", data.table::uniqueN(x$species)),
      stat("FG groups", if (has_group) data.table::uniqueN(stats::na.omit(x$FG_group)) else "-", if (!has_group) "no FG_group column")),
    if (length(warn)) tags$div(class = "alert alert-warning py-2 small mt-2 mb-2", lapply(warn, function(w) tags$div(w))),
    tags$div(class = "wm-fg-table mt-2",
      tags$table(class = "table table-sm table-striped",
        tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("FG_number"), tags$th("FG_name"), if (has_group) tags$th("FG_group"), tags$th("N species"))),
        tags$tbody(rows))))
})

## Coastal state of each GSA - the same table as GSA_COASTAL_STATE in 02_fisheries.R
.gsa_state <- c("1" = "Spain", "2" = "Spain", "3" = "Morocco", "4" = "Algeria", "5" = "Spain", "6" = "Spain",
                "7" = "France", "8" = "France", "9" = "Italy", "10" = "Italy", "11" = "Italy", "12" = "Tunisia")
.unsurveyed <- c(3, 4, 12)
## Expected minutes per script (01..05), from the 2026-10-15 run; 01 is much
## slower the first time after a change of GSAs (bathymetry download).
.step_min <- c(1.1, 1.5, 5.2, 1.2, 0.8)
.step_names <- c("01 biomass", "02 fisheries", "03 P/B, Q/B", "04 diets", "05 validation")

## --- Custom region from an uploaded shapefile / polygon file ---------------
custom_shape <- reactiveVal(NULL)   # list(path, sf) of the uploaded region
observeEvent(input$custom_shp, {
  up <- input$custom_shp
  name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", if (nzchar(input$area_name)) input$area_name else "custom_region")
  dest <- file.path(.run_dir, paste0("region_", name))
  unlink(dest, recursive = TRUE); dir.create(dest, recursive = TRUE)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(up))) {
    if (grepl("\\.zip$", up$name[i], ignore.case = TRUE)) utils::unzip(up$datapath[i], exdir = dest, junkpaths = TRUE)
    else file.copy(up$datapath[i], file.path(dest, up$name[i]), overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  f <- list.files(dest, "\\.(shp|geojson|json|gpkg|kml)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  f <- f[order(!grepl("\\.shp$", f, ignore.case = TRUE))][1]
  if (is.na(f)) { showNotification("No .shp, .geojson, .gpkg or .kml found in the upload.", type = "error"); return() }
  if (grepl("\\.shp$", f, ignore.case = TRUE) && !all(file.exists(sub("\\.shp$", c(".shx", ".dbf"), f, ignore.case = TRUE)))) {
    showNotification("A shapefile needs at least .shp, .shx and .dbf (and .prj for the CRS) - upload them together or as a .zip.", type = "error"); return() }
  g <- tryCatch(sf::st_read(f, quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) { showNotification(conditionMessage(e), type = "error"); NULL })
  if (is.null(g)) return()
  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(g))) sf::st_crs(g) <- 4326 else g <- sf::st_transform(g, 4326)
  g <- g[!sf::st_is_empty(g), ]
  custom_shape(list(path = normalizePath(f), sf = g))
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson"); sf::st_write(sf::st_geometry(g), tmp, quiet = TRUE)
  session$sendCustomMessage("wm-custom-shape", list(geojson = paste(readLines(tmp, warn = FALSE), collapse = "")))
})

## --- Area summary cards ---------------------------------------------------
output$area_summary <- renderUI({
  stat <- function(label, value, note = NULL, warn = FALSE)
    column(3, tags$div(class = paste("wm-stat", if (warn) "warn"),
                       tags$div(class = "l", label), tags$div(class = "v", value),
                       if (!is.null(note)) tags$div(class = "n", note)))
  if (identical(input$area_mode, "custom") && identical(input$custom_type, "shapefile")) {
    cs <- custom_shape()
    if (is.null(cs)) return(tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary mb-0", "Upload the region file to see it on the map."))
    a <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sum(sf::st_area(cs$sf)))) / 1e6
    bb <- sf::st_bbox(cs$sf)
    return(fluidRow(
      stat("Region", input$area_name, basename(cs$path)),
      stat("Polygons", nrow(cs$sf), "one model area each"),
      stat("Polygon area", paste(format(round(a, -2), big.mark = ","), "km\u00b2"), "as drawn, land included"),
      stat("Extent", sprintf("%.1f-%.1f\u00b0E", bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"]), sprintf("%.1f-%.1f\u00b0N", bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"]))))
  }
  if (identical(input$area_mode, "custom")) {
    b <- c(input$bbox_xmin, input$bbox_xmax, input$bbox_ymin, input$bbox_ymax)
    ok <- all(is.finite(b)) && b[2] > b[1] && b[4] > b[3]
    km2 <- if (ok) (b[2] - b[1]) * 111.32 * cos(mean(b[3:4]) * pi / 180) * (b[4] - b[3]) * 110.57 else NA
    return(fluidRow(
      stat("Region", input$area_name),
      stat("Box", if (ok) sprintf("%.1f-%.1f\u00b0E, %.1f-%.1f\u00b0N", b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4]) else "invalid", warn = !ok),
      stat("Box area", if (ok) paste(format(round(km2, -2), big.mark = ","), "km\u00b2") else "-", "rectangle, land included"),
      stat("Scripts", "01 biomass", "02-05 work on GSAs", warn = TRUE)))
  }
  g <- as.numeric(input$gsas)
  if (!length(g)) return(tags$div(class = "alert alert-danger mb-0", "No GSA selected - click the map or a quick-select button."))
  ## Area: from the depth cells 01 wrote (exact, from the bathymetry) when
  ## the last run covered these GSAs; otherwise the map polygons (whole GSA)
  cells <- model_cells()
  basis <- input$basis
  per_gsa <- if (!is.null(cells)) {
    keep <- if (identical(basis, "medits_10_800")) cells$Depth_min_m >= 10 & cells$Depth_max_m <= 800 else rep(TRUE, nrow(cells))
    tapply(cells$area_km2[keep], cells$AreaID[keep], sum)
  } else NULL
  have <- !is.null(per_gsa) && all(as.character(g) %in% names(per_gsa))
  fmt <- function(x) paste(format(round(x, -2), big.mark = ","), "km\u00b2")
  area_box <- if (have) {
    stat("Model area", fmt(sum(per_gsa[as.character(g)])),
         if (identical(basis, "medits_10_800")) "MEDITS strata 10-800 m, from the bathymetry (01)" else "whole GSA, coast to bottom (01)")
  } else if (identical(basis, "whole_gsa") && !is.null(.gsa_km2)) {
    stat("Model area", paste0("\u2248 ", fmt(sum(.gsa_km2[as.character(g)], na.rm = TRUE))), "from the map polygons; 01 computes the exact value")
  } else stat("Model area", "computed by 01", "these GSAs are not in the last run's model_area_cells.csv", warn = TRUE)
  uns <- intersect(g, .unsurveyed)
  fluidRow(
    stat("GSAs", length(g), paste(sort(g), collapse = ", ")),
    area_box,
    stat("Survey coverage", paste0(length(setdiff(g, .unsurveyed)), " of ", length(g)),
         if (length(uns)) paste0("GSA ", paste(uns, collapse = ", "), ": survey density assumed") else "all GSAs sampled by MEDITS",
         warn = length(uns) > 0),
    stat("Catch countries", length(unique(.gsa_state[as.character(g)])), paste(unique(.gsa_state[as.character(g)]), collapse = ", ")))
})

## --- Settings block: the exact code the Run button executes ---------------
config_code <- reactive({
  yr <- function(v) paste0(v[1], ":", v[2])
  tf <- function(x) if (isTRUE(x)) "TRUE" else "FALSE"
  common <- c(
    sprintf("YEAR_ECOPATH     <- %s   # Ecopath baseline", yr(input$ecopath_years)),
    sprintf("TS_YEARS         <- %s   # Ecosim biomass series", yr(input$ts_years)),
    sprintf("STRATA           <- %s", tf(input$strata)),
    sprintf("DROP_OUTLIERS    <- %s", tf(input$drop_outliers)),
    sprintf("NORMALIZE_TS     <- %s", tf(input$normalize_ts)),
    sprintf("ECOPATH_B_FILL_MODE  <- \"%s\"   # FGs with no Ecopath-years biomass", if (isTRUE(input$fill_b)) "window_mean" else "nearest"),
    if (isTRUE(input$fill_b) && length(input$fill_years) == 2) sprintf("ECOPATH_B_FILL_YEARS <- %s", yr(input$fill_years)),
    if (!is.na(fg_path())) sprintf("FG_SPECIES_FILE  <- \"%s\"   # species -> FG table", fg_path()))
  head <- c(sprintf("## WMed EwE pipeline settings - from medbs_pipeline_methodology.qmd, %s", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")),
            "## Run from the scripts/ folder of the repo (folders found by wmed_paths.R).",
            "CLEAN_START      <- FALSE   # keep the settings below")
  if (identical(input$area_mode, "custom")) {
    c(head,
      "AREA_MODE        <- \"custom\"",
      sprintf("AREA_NAME        <- \"%s\"", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", input$area_name)),
      if (identical(input$custom_type, "shapefile")) c(
        "CUSTOM_AREA_TYPE <- \"shapefile\"",
        sprintf("CUSTOM_SHAPEFILE_PATH <- \"%s\"", if (is.null(custom_shape())) "<upload the region file>" else custom_shape()$path))
      else c(
        "CUSTOM_AREA_TYPE <- \"bbox\"",
        sprintf("CUSTOM_BBOX      <- c(xmin = %s, xmax = %s, ymin = %s, ymax = %s)",
                input$bbox_xmin, input$bbox_xmax, input$bbox_ymin, input$bbox_ymax)),
      common,
      "source(\"01_biomass.R\")   # a custom region runs the biomass step (01)")
  } else {
    c(head,
      sprintf("RUN_STEPS        <- %s", input$steps),
      sprintf("MODEL_GSAS       <- c(%s)", paste(sort(as.numeric(input$gsas)), collapse = ", ")),
      sprintf("MODEL_AREA_BASIS <- \"%s\"", input$basis),
      common,
      "## catch / effort years (02) follow the Ecopath and Ecosim years",
      "source(\"run_pipeline_demo.R\")")
  }
})
output$config_text <- renderText(paste(config_code(), collapse = "\n"))
output$dl_config <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() if (identical(input$area_mode, "custom")) "wmed_custom_settings.R" else "wmed_pipeline_settings.R",
  content = function(file) writeLines(config_code(), file))

## --- Run -------------------------------------------------------------------
run_state <- reactiveVal("idle")          # idle | running | done | error
run_started <- reactiveVal(NULL)
run_finished <- reactiveVal(NULL)
run_steps <- reactiveVal(1:5)
step_seen <- reactiveVal(list())          # step number -> time its start line was first seen
last_finished <- reactiveVal(Sys.time())  # changes after every run -> images reload
run_note <- reactiveVal("")

.pid_alive <- function() {
  pid <- if (file.exists(.pid_file)) suppressWarnings(as.integer(readLines(.pid_file, warn = FALSE)[1])) else NA
  !is.na(pid) && isTRUE(tryCatch(tools::pskill(pid, 0L), error = function(e) FALSE))
}
.settings_lines <- function() if (file.exists(.settings_file)) readLines(.settings_file, warn = FALSE) else character(0)

## Reopened page: pick up the last run started from here (finished, failed,
## or still going)
if (file.exists(.settings_file)) {
  run_started(file.mtime(.settings_file))
  .st <- grep("^RUN_STEPS", .settings_lines(), value = TRUE)
  run_steps(tryCatch(eval(parse(text = sub("^[^<]*<-", "", .st[1]))), error = function(e) 1:5))
  if (file.exists(.status_file)) {
    run_state(if (identical(readLines(.status_file, warn = FALSE)[1], "done")) "done" else "error")
    run_finished(file.mtime(.status_file))
  } else if (.pid_alive()) {
    run_state("running")
  } else {
    run_state("error"); run_finished(file.mtime(.console))
    run_note("The last run from this page stopped without finishing (R or RStudio was closed?).")
  }
}

observe({   # the Run button is for GSA runs only (disabled= needs shiny >= 1.11)
  custom <- identical(input$area_mode, "custom")
  no_shape <- custom && identical(input$custom_type, "shapefile") && is.null(custom_shape())
  lab <- if (identical(run_state(), "running")) "Running..." else if (custom) "Run biomass (01) for this region" else "Run pipeline"
  if (utils::packageVersion("shiny") >= "1.11.0")
    updateActionButton(session, "run", label = lab, disabled = no_shape || identical(run_state(), "running")) else
    updateActionButton(session, "run", label = lab)
})

observeEvent(input$run, {
  custom <- identical(input$area_mode, "custom")
  if (identical(run_state(), "running")) return()
  if (custom && identical(input$custom_type, "shapefile") && is.null(custom_shape())) {
    showNotification("Upload the region file first.", type = "error"); return() }
  if (!custom && !length(input$gsas)) { showNotification("Select at least one GSA.", type = "error"); return() }
  unlink(c(.status_file, .progress_file, .console, .pid_file))
  writeLines(config_code(), .settings_file)
  Sys.setenv(WMED_PROGRESS_FILE = .progress_file)   # inherited by the Rscript process
  ## The settings block, with the final source() wrapped so the result is reported back here
  body <- config_code()
  body <- body[!grepl("^##", body)]
  body <- sub("^source\\(\"01_biomass.R\"\\).*$", paste0(
    "res <- tryCatch({ cat('--- Step 1/5: 01_biomass.R\\n', file = Sys.getenv('WMED_PROGRESS_FILE'), append = TRUE); ",
    "source('01_biomass.R'); cat('--- Step 1/5 done\\n', file = Sys.getenv('WMED_PROGRESS_FILE'), append = TRUE); 'done' }, ",
    "error = function(e) paste('error:', conditionMessage(e)))"), body)
  code <- paste(c(sprintf("writeLines(as.character(Sys.getpid()), '%s')", .pid_file), sub("^source\\(\"run_pipeline_demo.R\"\\)$",
                      "res <- tryCatch({ source('run_pipeline_demo.R'); 'done' }, error = function(e) paste('error:', conditionMessage(e)))", body),
                  sprintf("writeLines(res, '%s')", .status_file)), collapse = "\n")
  old <- setwd(file.path(.git_dir, "scripts")); on.exit(setwd(old))
  system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"), c("-e", shQuote(code)), wait = FALSE, stdout = .console, stderr = .console)
  run_state("running"); run_started(Sys.time()); run_finished(NULL); run_note(""); step_seen(list())
  run_steps(if (custom) 1L else eval(parse(text = input$steps)))
  showNotification(if (custom) paste0("Biomass step started for '", input$area_name, "' - outputs in out_dir/", input$area_name, ".")
                   else "Pipeline started - progress is shown below the button.", duration = 8)
})

## Poll the status file while a run is going
observe({
  if (!identical(run_state(), "running")) return()
  invalidateLater(5000)
  if (file.exists(.status_file)) {
    res <- readLines(.status_file, warn = FALSE)[1]
    run_state(if (identical(res, "done")) "done" else "error")
    run_finished(file.mtime(.status_file)); last_finished(Sys.time())
    showNotification(if (identical(res, "done")) "Pipeline finished - plots updated." else res,
                     type = if (identical(res, "done")) "message" else "error", duration = NULL)
  } else if (file.exists(.pid_file) && !.pid_alive()) {
    run_state("error"); run_finished(Sys.time()); last_finished(Sys.time())
    run_note("The run stopped without finishing - see the last lines below.")
  }
})

## Progress: read the "--- Step i/5: ..." / "--- Step i/5 done in x min ---"
## lines that run_pipeline_demo.R writes, and estimate the share done from
## the expected minutes per script.
output$run_progress <- renderUI({
  invalidateLater(3000)
  st <- run_state()
  if (identical(st, "idle")) {
    steps <- eval(parse(text = input$steps))
    return(tags$small(class = "text-muted", sprintf("Expected run time about %.0f min (%s).", sum(.step_min[steps]),
                                                   paste(.step_names[steps], collapse = ", "))))
  }
  lines <- if (file.exists(.progress_file)) readLines(.progress_file, warn = FALSE) else character(0)
  started <- as.integer(sub("^--- Step (\\d)/5:.*", "\\1", grep("^--- Step \\d/5: ", lines, value = TRUE)))
  finished <- as.integer(sub("^--- Step (\\d)/5 done.*", "\\1", grep("^--- Step \\d/5 done", lines, value = TRUE)))
  seen <- isolate(step_seen())
  for (k in setdiff(started, as.integer(names(seen)))) seen[[as.character(k)]] <- Sys.time()
  isolate(step_seen(seen))
  steps <- run_steps(); w <- .step_min[steps]
  current <- setdiff(started, finished); current <- if (length(current)) max(current) else NA
  done_min <- sum(.step_min[intersect(finished, steps)])
  cur_min <- if (!is.na(current)) min(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), seen[[as.character(current)]], units = "mins")),
                                      0.95 * .step_min[current]) else 0
  pct <- if (st == "done") 100 else round(100 * (done_min + cur_min) / sum(w))
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(if (is.null(run_finished())) Sys.time() else run_finished(), run_started(), units = "mins"))
  label <- switch(st,
    running = paste0(if (!is.na(current)) paste0("Running ", .step_names[current]) else "Starting",
                     " - ", length(intersect(finished, steps)), " of ", length(steps), " script(s) done - ",
                     sprintf("%.1f", elapsed), " min elapsed, about ", sprintf("%.0f", max(sum(w) - done_min - cur_min, 0)), " min left"),
    done = sprintf("Finished %s, in %.1f min", format(run_finished(), "%d %b %H:%M"), elapsed),
    error = "Stopped with an error - see below")
  colour <- switch(st, running = "bg-info", done = "bg-success", error = "bg-danger")
  ## one chip per script: done / running / waiting
  chips <- lapply(steps, function(k) {
    cls <- if (k %in% finished || st == "done") "bg-success" else if (identical(k, current)) "bg-info" else "bg-light text-dark"
    tags$span(class = paste("badge rounded-pill me-1", cls), .step_names[k])
  })
  tagList(
    tags$div(class = "progress mb-1", style = "height: 22px; border-radius: 11px;",
             tags$div(class = paste("progress-bar progress-bar-striped", colour, if (st == "running") "progress-bar-animated"),
                      role = "progressbar", style = paste0("width: ", pct, "%;"), paste0(pct, "%"))),
    tags$div(class = "mb-1", chips),
    tags$small(label))
})

output$run_status <- renderText({
  invalidateLater(5000)
  st <- run_state()
  tail_txt <- if (file.exists(.console)) paste(tail(readLines(.console, warn = FALSE), 3), collapse = "\n") else ""
  paste0("Status: ", st, "\nOutput folder: ", .out_dir,
         if (st == "error" && file.exists(.status_file)) paste0("\n", readLines(.status_file, warn = FALSE)[1]) else "",
         if (nzchar(run_note())) paste0("\n", run_note()) else "",
         if (nzchar(tail_txt)) paste0("\n--- last lines ---\n", tail_txt) else "")
})

## --- Files under out_dir for the figures in the text ------------------------
.ctype <- c(png = "image/png", csv = "text/csv", pdf = "application/pdf", txt = "text/plain",
            xlsx = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet")
.file_url <- session$registerDataObj("wmfile", .out_dir, function(data, req) {
  q <- shiny::parseQueryString(req$QUERY_STRING)
  root <- normalizePath(data, mustWork = FALSE)
  f <- normalizePath(file.path(data, if (is.null(q$f)) "" else q$f), mustWork = FALSE)
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(f))
  if (is.null(q$f) || !startsWith(f, root) || !file.exists(f) || dir.exists(f) || !ext %in% names(.ctype))
    return(list(status = 404L, headers = list("Content-Type" = "text/plain"), body = "not found"))
  list(status = 200L, headers = list("Content-Type" = .ctype[[ext]]), body = readBin(f, "raw", file.info(f)$size))
})
## Images kept in the repo (top folder and docs/): the workflow figure
.repo_url <- session$registerDataObj("wmrepo", .git_dir, function(data, req) {
  q <- shiny::parseQueryString(req$QUERY_STRING)
  root <- normalizePath(data, mustWork = FALSE)
  f <- normalizePath(file.path(data, if (is.null(q$f)) "" else q$f), mustWork = FALSE)
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(f))
  types <- c(jpg = "image/jpeg", jpeg = "image/jpeg", png = "image/png", svg = "image/svg+xml")
  if (is.null(q$f) || !startsWith(f, root) || !file.exists(f) || !ext %in% names(types))
    return(list(status = 404L, headers = list("Content-Type" = "text/plain"), body = "not found"))
  list(status = 200L, headers = list("Content-Type" = types[[ext]]), body = readBin(f, "raw", file.info(f)$size))
})
observe({   # tell the page where to load the figures from; again after every run
  last_finished()
  session$sendCustomMessage("wmfile-base", list(base = .file_url, repo = .repo_url, v = as.integer(Sys.time())))
})

## --- Folders on this computer -------------------------------------------------
output$folders <- renderUI({
  row <- function(label, path, from, ok)
    tags$tr(tags$td(if (ok) "\u2705" else "\u274C"), tags$td(tags$strong(label)),
            tags$td(tags$code(if (is.na(path)) "not found" else path)), tags$td(class = "text-muted", if (!is.na(from)) from))
  tagList(
    tags$table(class = "table table-sm mb-2", style = "font-size:.85rem;",
      row("Repo (git_dir)", .paths$git_dir, "this page's folder", dir.exists(file.path(.paths$git_dir, "scripts"))),
      row("pCloud data (pcloud_dir)", .paths$pcloud_dir, .paths$pcloud_from, !is.na(.paths$pcloud_dir)),
      row("Outputs (out_dir)", .paths$out_dir, .paths$out_from, dir.exists(.paths$out_dir))),
    if (is.na(.paths$pcloud_dir)) tags$div(class = "alert alert-danger py-2 small",
      "The pCloud folder '", .wmed_pcloud_name, "' was not found on this computer. Is pCloud Drive running? ",
      "Otherwise paste its path below and save."),
    tags$details(open = if (is.na(.paths$pcloud_dir)) NA else NULL,
      tags$summary(class = "small text-muted", "Change the folders for this computer"),
      fluidRow(
        column(5, textInput("set_pcloud", "pCloud folder", value = if (is.na(.paths$pcloud_dir)) "" else .paths$pcloud_dir, width = "100%")),
        column(5, textInput("set_out", "Output folder", value = .paths$out_dir, width = "100%")),
        column(2, tags$label(HTML("&nbsp;")), actionButton("save_folders", "Save", class = "btn-outline-primary w-100"))),
      tags$div(class = "wm-help", "Saved in config.local.R in the repo, for this computer only (not committed). Reopen the page after saving.")))
})
observeEvent(input$save_folders, {
  pc <- path.expand(trimws(input$set_pcloud)); od <- path.expand(trimws(input$set_out))
  if (!dir.exists(pc)) { showNotification(paste("Folder not found:", pc), type = "error"); return() }
  if (!dir.exists(od) && !dir.create(od, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)) {
    showNotification(paste("Cannot create:", od), type = "error"); return() }
  f <- wmed_save_local_config(.git_dir, out_dir = od, pcloud_dir = pc)
  showNotification(paste("Saved to", f, "- stop the page and open it again (Run Document)."), duration = NULL)
})

## --- Downloads: the output files of the last run ----------------------------
.wb_path   <- if (!is.na(.out_dir)) file.path(.out_dir, "ecopath_ecosim_inputs.xlsx") else NA_character_
.diet_path <- if (!is.na(.out_dir)) file.path(.out_dir, "diet", "diet_matrix_main_vs_reference.xlsx") else NA_character_
.out_tables <- function(pattern) {   # csv/xlsx under out_dir (not the plots or the page's run files)
  if (is.na(.out_dir)) return(character(0))
  f <- list.files(.out_dir, "\\.(csv|xlsx)$", recursive = TRUE)
  f <- f[!grepl("^(plots|plots_old|\\.qmd_run|isimip3a_cache|shapefiles|GFCM_GSA_shp)", f)]
  f[grepl(pattern, f)]
}
.send_file <- function(path) function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Not found: ", path, " - run the pipeline first.")
  file.copy(path, file)
}
.send_zip <- function(pattern) function(file) {
  f <- .out_tables(pattern)
  if (!length(f)) stop("No tables found in ", .out_dir, " - run the pipeline first.")
  old <- setwd(.out_dir); on.exit(setwd(old))
  if (requireNamespace("zip", quietly = TRUE)) zip::zip(file, f) else utils::zip(file, f, flags = "-q")
}
.stamp <- function() format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d")
output$dl_workbook <- downloadHandler(function() paste0("ecopath_ecosim_inputs_", .stamp(), ".xlsx"), .send_file(.wb_path))
output$dl_diet     <- downloadHandler(function() paste0("diet_matrix_main_vs_reference_", .stamp(), ".xlsx"), .send_file(.diet_path))
output$dl_review   <- downloadHandler(function() paste0("WMed_EwE_REVIEW_tables_", .stamp(), ".zip"), .send_zip("REVIEW"))
output$dl_all      <- downloadHandler(function() paste0("WMed_EwE_all_tables_", .stamp(), ".zip"), .send_zip("."))
output$dl_info <- renderUI({
  last_finished()
  if (is.na(.wb_path) || !file.exists(.wb_path)) return(tags$small(class = "text-muted", " No workbook yet - run the pipeline."))
  tags$small(class = "text-muted", sprintf(" Workbook written %s; %d tables in the output folder.",
                                           format(file.mtime(.wb_path), "%d %b %Y, %H:%M"), length(.out_tables("."))))
})

## --- Results: key plots and every plot in out_dir/plots ----------------------
## The PNGs are served straight from out_dir/plots (no copy); "?v=<time>"
## makes the browser fetch a plot again after a run rewrites it.
.plot_dir <- if (!is.na(.out_dir)) file.path(.out_dir, "plots") else NA_character_
## Served through the session (registerDataObj), which works inside Quarto;
## only files under out_dir/plots can be read this way.
.plot_url <- session$registerDataObj("wmplot", .plot_dir, function(data, req) {
  q <- shiny::parseQueryString(req$QUERY_STRING)
  root <- normalizePath(data, mustWork = FALSE)
  f <- normalizePath(file.path(data, if (is.null(q$f)) "" else q$f), mustWork = FALSE)
  if (is.null(q$f) || !startsWith(f, root) || !file.exists(f) || dir.exists(f))
    return(list(status = 404L, headers = list("Content-Type" = "text/plain"), body = "not found"))
  list(status = 200L, headers = list("Content-Type" = "image/png", "Cache-Control" = "max-age=3600"),
       body = readBin(f, "raw", file.info(f)$size))
})
.key_plots <- c("Biomass by source" = "biomass/biomass_by_fg_source.png",
                "Biomass series"    = "biomass/survey_fg_density_timeseries_regional.png",
                "Catch by FG"       = "fisheries/01_catches_per_FG.png",
                "F by FG"           = "validation/F_by_fg.png",
                "P/Q by FG"         = "validation/PQ_ratio_by_fg.png",
                "Diet matrix"       = "diets/diet_matrix_heatmap.png",
                "vs 1995 model"     = "validation/biomass_vs_old_model_by_fg.png")

output$results <- renderUI({
  last_finished(); st <- run_state()
  files <- if (!is.na(.plot_dir)) list.files(.plot_dir, "\\.png$", recursive = TRUE) else character(0)
  if (!length(files)) return(tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary py-2 small mb-0", "No plots yet - click Run pipeline."))
  mt <- file.mtime(file.path(.plot_dir, files)); names(mt) <- files
  src <- function(f) paste0(.plot_url, "&f=", utils::URLencode(f, reserved = TRUE), "&v=", as.integer(mt[[f]]))
  fmt <- function(t) format(t, "%d %b %Y, %H:%M")

  ## Where these plots come from
  newest <- max(mt)
  set <- .settings_lines()
  set <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(sub("#.*", "", set[grepl("^(MODEL_GSAS|MODEL_AREA_BASIS|YEAR_ECOPATH|TS_YEARS|START_YEAR|END_YEAR|DROP_OUTLIERS)", set)])))
  from_here <- !is.null(run_finished()) && !is.null(run_started()) &&
               newest >= run_started() && newest <= run_finished() + 120
  banner <- if (identical(st, "running")) {
    tags$div(class = "alert alert-warning py-2 small", "A run is going. These are the previous plots; they are replaced when it finishes.")
  } else if (from_here && identical(st, "done")) {
    tags$div(class = "alert alert-success py-2 small",
             tags$strong("From the run started on this page "), sprintf("on %s, finished %s. ", fmt(run_started()), fmt(run_finished())),
             tags$br(), tags$code(paste(set, collapse = "; ")))
  } else {
    tags$div(class = "alert alert-info py-2 small",
             sprintf("Plots last written %s by a run outside this page (from the R console or another session).", fmt(newest)),
             if (!is.null(run_started())) sprintf(" The last run from this page was on %s.", fmt(run_started())))
  }

  ## Key plots: one tab each
  ids <- paste0("wm-key-", seq_along(.key_plots))
  key_nav <- tags$ul(class = "nav nav-tabs", role = "tablist",
    lapply(seq_along(.key_plots), function(i)
      tags$li(class = "nav-item", role = "presentation",
              tags$button(class = paste("nav-link", if (i == 1) "active"), type = "button", role = "tab",
                          `data-bs-toggle` = "tab", `data-bs-target` = paste0("#", ids[i]), names(.key_plots)[i]))))
  key_body <- tags$div(class = "tab-content",
    lapply(seq_along(.key_plots), function(i) {
      f <- .key_plots[[i]]
      tags$div(class = paste("tab-pane fade", if (i == 1) "show active"), id = ids[i], role = "tabpanel",
               if (f %in% files) tags$img(class = "wm-key-img", src = src(f), alt = basename(f))
               else tags$div(class = "alert alert-secondary small mt-2", "Not available yet: plots/", f))
    }))

  ## All plots: thumbnails, filter by folder, search by name
  folder <- dirname(files)
  ord <- order(folder, basename(files)); files <- files[ord]; folder <- folder[ord]
  counts <- table(folder)
  filt <- tags$div(class = "wm-filter",
    tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary active", `data-folder` = "", sprintf("All (%d)", length(files))),
    lapply(names(counts), function(d)
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary", `data-folder` = d, sprintf("%s (%d)", d, counts[[d]]))),
    tags$input(id = "wm-search", type = "search", class = "form-control form-control-sm", placeholder = "Search plot name"))
  grid <- tags$div(class = "wm-grid",
    lapply(seq_along(files), function(i)
      tags$div(class = "wm-thumb", `data-folder` = folder[i], `data-name` = tolower(basename(files[i])),
               tags$img(src = src(files[i]), loading = "lazy", alt = basename(files[i]), title = "Click to zoom"),
               tags$div(class = "wm-thumb-folder", folder[i]),
               tags$div(class = "wm-thumb-name", sub("\\.png$", "", basename(files[i]))))))

  tagList(
    banner,
    tags$ul(class = "nav nav-pills wm-view", role = "tablist",
      tags$li(class = "nav-item", tags$button(class = "nav-link active", type = "button", `data-bs-toggle` = "pill",
                                              `data-bs-target` = "#wm-view-key", "Key plots")),
      tags$li(class = "nav-item", tags$button(class = "nav-link", type = "button", `data-bs-toggle` = "pill",
                                              `data-bs-target` = "#wm-view-all", sprintf("All plots (%d)", length(files))))),
    tags$div(class = "tab-content",
      tags$div(class = "tab-pane fade show active", id = "wm-view-key", key_nav, key_body),
      tags$div(class = "tab-pane fade", id = "wm-view-all", filt, grid)),
    tags$small(class = "text-muted", "Click any plot to zoom. Plots are read from ", tags$code(.plot_dir), "."))
})
```

| Input | Script variable | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| GSAs (map, checkboxes) | `MODEL_GSAS` (→ `FILTER_AREAS`) | GSAs of the model area (default 1-12). Survey data only from these GSAs; GSAs 3, 4 and 12 (no MEDITS) take the survey density per km² of the others (assumption). Catch kept for every coastal state of these GSAs. |
| Area basis | `MODEL_AREA_BASIS` | `whole_gsa`: A_model is the whole sea area of the GSAs, coast to bottom. `medits_10_800`: only the 10-800 m MEDITS strata. |
| Custom region | `AREA_MODE = "custom"`, `AREA_NAME`, `CUSTOM_AREA_TYPE`, `CUSTOM_SHAPEFILE_PATH` or `CUSTOM_BBOX` | A region from an uploaded shapefile (.zip, or .shp + .shx + .dbf + .prj), GeoJSON, GeoPackage or KML, or a lon/lat box, instead of GSAs. Runs the biomass step (01) for that region; outputs in `out_dir/<AREA_NAME>/` (@sec-area-definition, Approach B). |
| Ecopath baseline | `YEAR_ECOPATH` | Years averaged into Ecopath_B, F and P/B (01, 02, 03). |
| Ecosim biomass series | `TS_YEARS` | Years of the Ecosim biomass series (01). |
| (no input) | `START_YEAR`, `END_YEAR` | Catch, landings, discards and effort series (02) follow the other years: from the first Ecopath or Ecosim year to the last Ecosim year (set in `run_pipeline_demo.R`). |
| Strata-weighted density | `STRATA` (default `TRUE`) | Depth-stratum, area-weighted estimator (@sec-strata-weighted) vs a simple mean. |
| Remove outliers | `DROP_OUTLIERS` (default `TRUE`) | Flagged outlier hauls removed, or only reported in `survey_outliers_flagged.csv`. |
| Relative Ecosim series | `NORMALIZE_TS` (default `TRUE`) | Ecosim series as an index (first value = 1) or raw density. |
| Fill missing Ecopath_B | `ECOPATH_B_FILL_MODE`, `ECOPATH_B_FILL_YEARS` (default on, 1995-2000) | An FG with no biomass in the Ecopath years gets its mean over these years (else the nearest year with data); off = nearest single year only. Expanding FGs always get 0.00001 t/km². |
| Scripts to run | `RUN_STEPS` | `1:5` all; `2:5` reuses the biomass on disk; `5` redraws the validation only. |

The model-area figure in the summary is a preview from the simplified map polygons (about 1 % above the real value); the A_model used in the outputs is the one 01 computes and writes to `model_area_by_gsa.csv`.

---

## Overview

This tool builds the inputs of Ecopath with Ecosim (EwE) models of the Western Mediterranean: biomass per Functional Group (FG) for the Ecopath baseline and the Ecosim time series, catch, landings, discards and effort by fleet, fishing mortality, P/B and Q/B, the diet matrix, and a validation against the 1995 Western Mediterranean model. It runs as five R scripts (01 biomass, 02 fisheries, 03 P/B and Q/B, 04 diets, 05 validation) from the page above, or from the R console, and writes everything to one Excel workbook plus review tables.

**Biomass first:** the starting point is a time series of biomass density per Functional Group — how much of each modeled group is really out there, year by year, for whichever region and time window is configured. Everything else in the wider pipeline (catches, mortality, production, diet) is expressed relative to this density, so getting it right — correctly weighted by survey stratum and area, not just averaged naively — is what lets the rest of the model be trusted.

The biomass step has two layers:

1. **A shared, survey-agnostic function library** (`lib_survey_fg_density_functions.R`) - the statistical logic (strata weighting, area weighting, outlier detection, catchability correction) that doesn't depend on which survey or which study area boundary is being used.
2. **One Step-1 driver script, `01_biomass.R`,** that reads the survey's raw files, reshapes them into the library's standardized input format and calls the shared functions. `AREA_MODE` picks the study area:
   - `AREA_MODE = "westmed"` (default) - MEDITS bottom-trawl data, study area defined by the official GFCM GSA polygons (`MODEL_GSAS`, set in `run_pipeline_demo.R` with the years; default GSAs 1–12, the Western Med with Northern Tunisia; MEDITS/MEDIAS data exist for GSAs 1, 2, 5–11). Also incorporates MEDIAS acoustic survey data (@sec-medias), combined with MEDITS into a single density index, and sources `01b_biomass_unsurveyed.R` for the groups the surveys cannot measure (@sec-biomass). Outputs in `out_dir/biomass/` and `out_dir/plots/biomass/`.
   - `AREA_MODE = "custom"` - the same MEDITS data with a custom boundary (a shapefile or other polygon file uploaded on the page, a lon/lat box, or a custom GSA grouping; `CUSTOM_AREA_TYPE`) - useful when the same survey supports a different EwE model with its own footprint. MEDITS-only. Outputs in `out_dir/<AREA_NAME>/` (default `custom_region`), so the two modes never overwrite each other.

Code chunks throughout are **not executed** when this document renders (`eval: false`) - they're shown for reference alongside the explanation, since the pipeline depends on external data files and network access (bathymetry downloads, WoRMS taxonomy lookups) not available at render time. Run the source `.R` scripts directly to reproduce the actual numbers. (The figures are the exception: each one is loaded from your output folder when the page opens, so it always shows the latest run; a figure whose script has not run yet shows a short note instead.)

The pipeline covers several conceptually distinct problems in sequence:

1. **Which Functional Group does each species belong to?** (@sec-fg-matching)
2. **What study area am I actually working with?** (@sec-area-definition)
3. **Given catch and effort, what's the correctly-standardized density for each haul?** (@sec-density, including catchability correction and outlier removal)
4. **Given that, what's the correctly-weighted density estimate for each FG?** (@sec-strata-weighted, @sec-regional)
5. **For the westmed script specifically: how does a second, structurally different survey (acoustic, not trawl) get folded into the same index?** (@sec-medias)

### Pipeline flow

```{r}
#| echo: false
wm_repo_figure("fig-flow-overview", r"---(Workflow: the species-to-Functional-Group table and the data sources feed four blocks (1 biomass, 2 fisheries, 3 P/B, Q/B and traits, 4 diets) that produce the EwE input. Click to zoom.)---", "ewe_infography.jpg")
```

```{mermaid}
%%| eval: true

flowchart LR
    A1["Direct match (ScientificName lookup)"] --> A2["Nominate subspp. (repeated-word names)"]
    A2 --> A3["Taxonomy fallback (genus to phylum)"]
    A3 --> A4["Seed rules (rank to FG, no data)"]
    A4 --> A5["Manual review"]
```

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-flow-density-weighting

%%| eval: true
%%{init: {'flowchart': {'padding': 20, 'nodeSpacing': 60, 'rankSpacing': 90}, 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '20px'}}}%%
flowchart LR
    B1["Sample density (biomass / effort)"] --> B2(["Catchability (if q table given)"])
    B2 --> B3["Outlier removal (per species, per area)"]
    B3 --> B4(["Strata weighting (if strata = true)"])

    class B1,B3 teal
    class B2,B4,B5 teal
```

Dashed/rounded boxes above are conditional: catchability correction only runs if a catchability table is provided, strata weighting only if `strata = TRUE` (otherwise a simple mean density is used instead), and area weighting is only meaningful with more than one area in scope (with a single custom region, it still runs but is mathematically a formality - see @sec-regional).

Problems 3 and 4 are the most statistically subtle - a naive average across hauls, or treating every survey estimate as if the gear caught 100% of what was present, can be quietly wrong in ways that matter for the final model.

## Input files {#sec-inputs}

Every file the pipeline actually reads, traced directly from `01_biomass.R` (both `AREA_MODE`s)'s own variable assignments - not a general description, the literal paths and variable names used in the code.

| File | Variable | Used for | Required? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FG_WMed_2026.csv` | `fg_file` | Species→FG reference master (`dataframe2`, @sec-fg-matching) | Yes, both scripts |
| `TM_list_(April_2019).xlsx` | `tm_list_file` | MEDITS species code → `ScientificName` lookup | Yes, both scripts |
| `TA.csv` | loaded as `ta` | MEDITS haul-level metadata - station, depth, swept area, effort | Yes, both scripts |
| `TB.csv` | loaded as `tb` | MEDITS catch-per-haul records | Yes, both scripts |
| `ASFIS_sp_2026.1.csv` | `asfis_file` | FAO species code list - MEDIAS species code → `ScientificName` (@sec-medias) | westmed only |
| `abundance.csv` / `biomass.csv` | in `medias_dir` | MEDIAS acoustic survey raw records (@sec-medias) | westmed only |
| `catchability_factors_ecotrans_medits_2021_spp.csv` | `CATCHABILITY_CSV_PATH` | Optional per-species catchability correction factors (@sec-density) | Optional - falls back to `q = 1` (no correction) if missing |
| GFCM GSA shapefile (`GFCM_GSA.zip`) | downloaded to `area_shp` | Official GSA boundary polygons (@sec-area-definition, Approach A) | westmed only - downloaded automatically, not a local file |
| NOAA bathymetry raster | downloaded via `marmap::getNOAA.bathy()` | Stratum area computation (@sec-strata-weighted) | Both scripts - downloaded automatically |
| Custom shapefile / bounding box | `CUSTOM_BBOX` or a user-supplied shapefile path | Study area definition (@sec-area-definition, Approach B) | custom script only |

::: {.callout-note}
### Species → FG table: `FG_WMed_2026.csv`
The species → functional group assignment comes from `FG_WMed_2026.csv` (pCloud `data` folder), built and reviewed for the EwE Western Mediterranean model. One row per species, with its `FG_number` and `FG_name` (plus `Genus`, `Family`, `Order`, `Class`, `Phylum`, `source` and `status`). Scripts 01-04 all read it. Another file with the same columns can be chosen or uploaded in the *Functional groups* card (@sec-configure), which sets `FG_SPECIES_FILE` for the run.
:::

All the pCloud-hosted files above share one root, `pcloud_dir`, the pCloud Drive folder `EwE Western Med 2026`. `scripts/wmed_paths.R` finds it on any laptop with pCloud Drive and the repo: first a path in `config.local.R` (this computer only, not committed), then `config.R`, then the standard pCloud Drive place (macOS `~/pCloud Drive/`, Windows `P:/`, Linux `~/pCloudDrive/`). A path that does not exist on this computer is skipped. The outputs go to `out_dir` (from the same files, default `~/WMed_EwE_output`). The *Folders on this computer* card at the top of the page shows the folders found and lets you change them.

::: {.callout-note}
### Two downloads happen automatically - no local file needed
The GSA shapefile and the bathymetry raster aren't files you provide - both are fetched over the network the first time a script needs them (from GFCM's own Azure blob storage, and from NOAA respectively) and cached locally afterward (`gsa_shp_dir`/`GFCM_GSA_shp` for the shapefile; wherever `getNOAA.bathy()`'s own cache lands, keyed by the bounding box requested) so re-running the script doesn't re-download every time. This is also why `eval: false` on the code chunks throughout this document matters (@sec-configure) - reproducing this pipeline's actual output needs live network access at least once, which isn't guaranteed at render time.
:::

```{r}
#| label: bathymetry-download
#| code-fold: false
## Real call, from lib_survey_fg_density_functions.R's strata-area
## computation (@sec-strata-weighted) - bbox comes from the study
## area's own extent (a GSA polygon or the custom region), so this
## downloads only the bathymetry actually needed, not the whole
## Mediterranean every time.
bathy <- marmap::getNOAA.bathy(lon1 = bbox["xmin"], lon2 = bbox["xmax"],
                                lat1 = bbox["ymin"], lat2 = bbox["ymax"],
                                resolution = 1, keep = TRUE)
bathy_r <- marmap::as.raster(bathy)
```
